verdict.rationale: Granola's own site says it 'uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot' and works with Zoom, Meet, Teams and other meeting apps, capturing any audio playing from the device. That covers the core of bot-free, device-side capture and transcription. However, the docs also say Granola posts a message in the meeting chat when it starts transcribing, and the evidence does not say whether this is optional, so participants may see something extra. Missing for 10: clarity on whether the in-meeting chat notice is opt-in or can be disabled, and independent hands-on confirmation that participants see nothing during a call.
